purpose: Apply KDE Tooltip roles to QtQuick6 attached hints when the native popup becomes visible, without polling; retain QtQuick5 behavior.

implementation.behavior: Connections listens for visibleChanged on the shared window-attached popup, menu rows and TableView cell popup; applies Kirigami.Theme.Tooltip to popup, content and background after opening. No polling timer. QtQuick5 excludes Qt6-only Kirigami Theme diagnostics and keeps its existing tooltip route.
implementation.colors: Role values are resolved from the active KDE/Kirigami palette; no final RGB constants were added.

qtquick6_disabled_target_matrix.rerun: Final R141 source: 7/7 targets, 0 skipped, 0 non-hoverable, 0 failures; each live attached popup matched the KDE Tooltip role.

evidence.qtquick6_hover_and_menu: Real QtQuick6/org.kde.desktop push button and menu row: declared delay 750 ms, no early appearance, stable 400 ms, no owner overlap, inside screen, dismisses on leave, menu stays open until action. Menu-row foreground/background matched Tooltip roles in each palette.

limitations: Covers this QtQuick gallery and menu samples, not every Theme Lab layout or every lazy delegate.
QtQuick6 gallery still emits the existing KDE TabButton.qml null-y TypeError at startup; it did not fail these hover tests and is not attributed to this change.
Tests used private HOME/XDG/bus on owned Xephyr; no personal palette or desktop setting changed.
No theme release/install or visual user approval is claimed.
